shared_elements: low-relief carving on an upright rounded-topped monolithic surface
a band or line running horizontally across the surface, dividing zones
justification: Both surfaces are upright, rounded-topped monoliths carved in shallow relief with curvilinear motifs, rings/discs and a horizontal band dividing an upper from a lower zone, which is about as generic a correspondence as two carving traditions can share. A depicts a narrative scene with a horse, human figures and dense woven interlace filling framed panels, whereas B shows only a few isolated, widely spaced ring and curl signs with a broad girdle-like band and no figures or animals at all.
